confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Accommodation and drinks are least certain given island and seasonal premiums. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer price (about 2.2x and 2.6x beer). Local examples assume roughly 33 THB per USD. The FX value comes from search summaries attributed to the RBA, not a direct page read; a 15 Oct 2026 figure of 0.6955 was reported but could not be confirmed, so verify on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; regional basis is tourist-zone pricing in southern Thai beach towns such as Phuket, Krabi and Hua Hin, with a modest island premium on accommodation.
